column3: Close to the Hebrew; “In the nights” is rendered “night after night.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will arise, please” is rendered “I must arise now,” and NASB marks the words as inner speech.
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “And I said.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Like a little” is rendered “Scarcely.”
The oath formula “if you awaken” is rendered “That you will not arouse,” and “the love … until it pleases” as “my love, Until she pleases.”
“Who [is] this” is rendered “What is this,” and “a trader” as “the merchant.”
Close to the Hebrew; “His bed, which is Solomon’s” is rendered “the traveling couch of Solomon,” and “warriors” as “mighty men.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Grasped of a sword” is rendered “wielders of the sword,” “on his thigh” as “at his side,” and NASB adds “Guarding against.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Litter” is rendered “sedan chair.”
“Its middle fitted out [with] love from the daughters of Jerusalem” is rendered “With its interior lovingly fitted out By the daughters of Jerusalem.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “Come out and look” is rendered “Go forth … and gaze.”
